activity_summary: You set the order: the tables, then the clean sheet, workmen first and the queen after. You told yourself again not to count the pile, and not to start with an ending.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: If I begin with her I will punish her to have an ending, and I have not got one.
